items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 August 2026 9:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 09 August 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Norway and high pressure to the southwest of Ireland building a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east at first, becoming variable 2 to 4 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain continuing to clear the southeast of the area, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, becoming east or southeast 3 or 4 overnight into Tuesday, occasionally 5 in the east. Veering south or southeast later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
